map.多道焊时把层间温度控制在合理窗口，防止热影响区脆化或耐蚀性下降。: In multi-pass welding keep the interpass temperature inside a sensible window to prevent heat-affected zone embrittlement or loss of corrosion resistance.
map.检查预热温度是否超过该材料允许的最高层间温度，提前发现工艺冲突。: Check whether the preheat temperature exceeds the maximum interpass temperature allowed for that material, catching process conflicts early.
map.最低层间温度取预热温度；最高层间温度按材料：低碳钢 300℃、低合金钢 250℃: Take the minimum interpass temperature as the preheat temperature. Maximum interpass temperature by material: low-carbon steel 300°C, low-alloy steel 250°C, austenitic stainless steel 150°C, martensitic stainless steel 350°C. Control points: keep low-carbon steel at or below 300°C to avoid grain coarsening and lost toughness; low-alloy steel at ≤250°C to prevent heat-affected zone embrittlement; austenitic stainless steel below 150°C to avoid carbide precipitation that reduces corrosion resistance; martensitic stainless steel needs a higher interpass temperature plus post-weld heat treatment. If the preheat temperature exceeds the maximum interpass temperature, the tool flags the conflict.
map.低合金钢 Q345 预热 150℃：推荐层间温度 150~250℃。若实测层间温: Low-alloy steel Q345 preheated to 150°C: recommended interpass temperature 150~250°C. If the measured interpass temperature climbs to 280°C, above the 250°C limit, welding should pause to cool or the welding rhythm should be adjusted, to avoid a loss of heat-affected zone toughness. For austenitic stainless steel 304 with a preheat setting of 180°C, above its 150°C limit, the tool reports a conflict.
map.层间温度过低有什么问题？: What problems does too low an interpass temperature cause?
map.低于预热温度会使后续焊道的冷却速度加快，增加淬硬与冷裂纹风险，尤其对厚板与高碳当: Staying below the preheat temperature speeds up cooling of the subsequent passes and raises the risk of hardening and cold cracking, especially for thick plate and high-carbon-equivalent steels. That is why the minimum interpass temperature is normally not below the preheat temperature.
map.奥氏体不锈钢为什么要控得这么低？: Why does austenitic stainless steel have to be kept so low?
map.奥氏体不锈钢在 500~800℃ 区间停留会析出碳化铬造成晶间贫铬（敏化），降低: Austenitic stainless steel that lingers in the 500~800°C range precipitates chromium carbide, causing intergranular chromium depletion (sensitization) and lowering corrosion resistance. Controlling the interpass temperature shortens the time spent in that range.
